# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root and follow it. The rule that must
never be missed: no AI product attribution anywhere in this repository. Do
not add `Co-authored-by`, "Generated with ...", session or agent links, or the
name of any AI tool, including Copilot, to commits, pull request titles or
bodies, issues, comments, code, docs, branch names, tags or labels.
